search.query: | mstats avg("netqual.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("netqual.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("carrier","operstate_up") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("netqual.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*speed_mbps*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("netqual.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*rx_errors*","*tx_errors*","*rx_drops*","*tx_drops*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
